column1: # Debian and Ubuntu releases the polycall APT repository supports.
# Single source of truth for packaging/deb/build.sh, packaging/apt/*.sh,
# packaging/test/*.sh and the GitHub Actions matrices
#   codename      APT suite name (= VERSION_CODENAME in /etc/os-release)
#   image         clean Docker image used to build and to test installs
#   suffix        appended to the Debian version: 1.0.0-1~<suffix>, so each
#                 release gets its own build and a release upgrade (e.g.
#   architectures space separated; each one is built, tested and published
# Adding a release: add a row, then run the packaging workflow on a PR; it
# builds, lints and install-tests every row before anything is published.
